topic: Reviewing historical impression data and API access
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on retrieving large-scale historical analytics, specifically the peak real-time impressions recorded in 2024 and the total annual impression count. The participant confirmed that API usage is billed separately from subscriptions.

Later, the conversation shifted to technical setup, with one participant adding another user to an OpenAI organization for API access.
